article.title: Google、「Gemini 4 Carbon」発表　「Argon」公開から2週間、サイバー防御能力などを強化
article.summary: Googleは、フロンティアAIモデル「Gemini 4 Carbon」を発表した。サイバーセキュリティや長時間に及ぶ自律作業能力を強化し、ベンチマーク首位を獲得。ハルシネーションや不正操作への耐性も向上させた。まず一部のサイバー防御組織に限定提供し、順次公開範囲を広げる方針だ。

all_candidates.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
all_candidates.summary: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.

all_candidates.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
all_candidates.summary: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.
